description: Create and normalize a draft multi-agent workflow without saving it. Use this before validating or committing a generated workflow.

draft.description: Workflow draft object with name, summary, goal, pattern, systemInstruction, agents, and connections. If agents are omitted, a coordinator/specialist draft is generated from the goal.
draft.name: draft

draft_json.description: Alternative JSON string representation of the workflow draft.
draft_json.name: draft_json

goal.description: High-level workflow goal used when no draft object is supplied.
goal.name: goal

name.description: Workflow name used when no draft object is supplied.
name.name: name

name: create_multi_agent_workflow_draft

draft_id.description: Temporary draft identifier that can be passed to validate or commit.
draft_id.name: draft_id

valid.description: Whether the draft can be committed.
valid.name: valid
